dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about your fruit stand.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: It's not so much about how much it cost...

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: It's more that once you've got rotten fruit on it, it's a nightmare to clean. The juices go all slimy and stick to it for ages, and the smell is nearly impossible to get rid of...

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: If I don't get it cleaned in good time, my wife will kill me when I get back.
